son art aux autres.

en.name: Callie Graffy
en.description:
Her handwriting is so nice, people
are always asking her for lessons.

fr.name: Ant Anomy
fr.description:
Calé en anatomie, il cherche comment
appliquer ses connaissances au sport.

en.name: Ant Anomy
en.description:
He puts his anatomical knowledge
to good use while exercising.

fr.name: Laurie Nowlin
fr.description:
Pourchasse sans peur les harceleurs.
Même les délinquants la craignent.

en.name: Laurie Nowlin
en.description:
She'll fearlessly stick up for anyone being bullied.
Even delinquents fear her.

fr.name: Lucille Strummon
fr.description:
Apprend à jouer du shamisen et y
excelle déjà.

en.name: Lucille Strummon
en.description:
She learnt to play the banjo from
her gran and puts pros to shame.

fr.name: Leon Hotair
fr.description:
Insiste sur l'importance de la
motivation, mais sèche l'entraînement.

en.name: Leon Hotair
en.description:
He claims football demands commitment,
but he's a serial slacker.

fr.name: John Bleach
fr.description:
Type admirable qui nettoie les
toilettes consciencieusement.

en.name: John Bleach
en.description:
He cleans the school toilets
to a fine polish.

fr.name: Carey Filling
fr.description:
Les friandises dont il raffole sont
toujours en rupture de stock.

en.name: Carey Filling
en.description:
This tragic figure always arrives at the
bakery just as they sell the last loaf.

fr.name: Conn Fuchus
fr.description:
Adore la poésie chinoise et porte
toujours son recueil sur lui.

en.name: Conn Fuchus
en.description:
An avid fan of classical poetry,
he always has a book of it on hand.

fr.name: Iain Igma
fr.description:
Personne n'arrive à résoudre les
casse-tête en bois qu'il construit.

en.name: Iain Igma
en.description:
He carves wooden puzzles that
nobody can solve.

fr.name: Carrie O'Kea
fr.description:
Adore le karaoké et est équipée
pour en faire à la maison.

en.name: Carrie O'Kea
en.description:
An avid karaoke fan who has her
own karaoke setup at home.

fr.name: Stuart Leafe
fr.description:
Thé noir ou thé vert, aucune
infusion n'a de secret pour lui.

en.name: Stuart Leafe
en.description:
From green tea to black tea and Ceylon too.
he's mastered the art of every brew.

fr.name: Cole Stoaker
fr.description:
Il aime cuisiner en pleine nature et
part souvent camper.

en.name: Cole Stoaker
en.description:
A camping fan, he loves cooking in
the wild and sleeping under the stars.

fr.name: Justin Primm
fr.description:
Confierait bien les tâches du
magasin familial à un chien.

en.name: Justin Primm
en.description:
He hates helping out in the family
shop, so leaves his dog in charge.

fr.name: Mark Smudge
fr.description:
Adore croquer la ville avec ses
crayons de couleur.

en.name: Mark Smudge
en.description:
He loves sketching the town with
colored pencils.

fr.name: Travis Borer
fr.description:
Comédien de Rakugo talentueux qui songe à
intégrer une école de théâtre une fois diplomé.

en.name: Travis Borer
en.description:
He'd love to be a stand-up comedian,
but hasn't got any jokes yet...

fr.name: Anton Donce
fr.description:
N'a jamais manqué un cours ni été
en retard de toute sa vie.

en.name: Anton Donce
en.description:
He's been gunning for a perfect attendance
record ever since starting school.

fr.name: Chase Spoor
fr.description:
Évalue les distances avec précision
d'un simple regard.

en.name: Chase Spoor
en.description:
He can track his opponents precisely
no matter how far away they are.

fr.name: George Barros
fr.description:
Ne plaît qu'aux filles plus âgées et
rêve d'une copine plus jeune.

en.name: George Barros
en.description:
Older girls like him, but he's looking
for someone his own age.

fr.name: Olivia Baker
fr.description:
Elle adore préparer des festins et
recevoir des invités.

en.name: Olivia Baker
en.description:
She likes making dinner for friends
and hopes to run a restaurant.

fr.name: Gem Shorn
fr.description:
Si doué à l'ocarina que même les
oiseaux s'approchent quand il joue.

en.name: Gem Shorn
en.description:
A talented ocarina player. Birds
even come and listen to him play.

fr.name: Lou Daguerre
fr.description:
Doué pour construire des dioramas
plus vrais que nature.

en.name: Lou Daguerre
en.description:
An expert diorama maker, his models
are just like the real thing.

fr.name: Ollie Tuckney
fr.description:
Aime le skateboard et cherche sans
cesse à créer de nouvelles figures.

en.name: Ollie Tuckney
en.description:
He's nuts about skateboarding and
is always practicing new tricks.

fr.name: Manuel Kinart
fr.description:
Fait des expériences et cherche à
donner vie à des poupées.

en.name: Manuel Kinart
en.description:
A string puppet enthusiast who hope
to bring them back into fashion.

fr.name: Skip Vinall
fr.description:
Décorer sa chambre de pochettes de
disques est sa passion.

en.name: Skip Vinall
en.description:
His hobby is decorating his walls
with classic record sleeves.

fr.name: Junior Gambit
fr.description:
Champion d'échecs. A déjà participé
à des tournois internationaux.

en.name: Junior Gambit
en.description:
This chess master has taken part
in world-class junior tournaments.

fr.name: Florian Fauna
fr.description:
Peut apprivoiser la plus féroce des
bêtes en un instant.

en.name: Florian Fauna
en.description:
He has a knack for befriending
animals, no matter how wild.

fr.name: Clark Tappen
fr.description:
Un as de la calculette. Tape plus vite que
son ombre.

en.name: Clark Tappen
en.description:
This pocket calculator maestro's fingers
are just a blur on the keys.

fr.name: Ryan O'Laugh
fr.description:
Passe ses hivers à faire du saut à
ski, son loisir favori.

en.name: Ryan O'Laugh
en.description:
A fan of ski jumping, he hits the
slopes every day in the winter.

fr.name: Rod Sweeper
fr.description:
Retourne les objets perdus à leur
propriétaire, même l'argent.

en.name: Rod Sweeper
en.description:
He has a habit of finding lost items and
once uncovered a fortune in banknotes.

fr.name: Reg Strimmer
fr.description:
Aime tailler les haies. Le sécateur
le titille face à un buisson hirsute.

en.name: Reg Strimmer
en.description:
A tip-top topiary talent who trims
hedges like there's no tomorrow.

fr.name: Will Ramin
fr.description:
Fonce la tête la première et enfonce
tout sur son passage.

en.name: Will Ramin
en.description:
A firm believer in the direct approach,
he likes to rush in head first.

fr.name: Andy Fudge
fr.description:
Type gentil qui peut se déchaîner s'il
s'agit d'aider la fille qu'il aime.

en.name: Andy Fudge
en.description:
Usually a placid character, he only
gets fired up when he's in love.

fr.name: Tate Immy
fr.description:
Imite n'importe quel instrument de
musique avec sa bouche.

en.name: Tate Immy
en.description:
He can imitate the sound of any musical
instrument with his mouth.

fr.name: Gerald Pourer
fr.description:
Ne se bagarre pas, mais a toujours
le corps couvert de bleus.

en.name: Gerald Pourer
en.description:
He's always covered in cuts and bruises,
though he swears he hasn't been fighting.

fr.name: Nate Checker
fr.description:
Champion de shogi. A déjà le niveau
pour devenir pro.

en.name: Nate Checker
en.description:
This genius chess player has already
seen success at pro level.

fr.name: Bomber Pikes
fr.description:
Excelle en plongeon. Massif, ses
entrées dans l'eau sont tonitruantes.

en.name: Bomber Pikes
en.description:
This famous high diver's so heavy,
he always makes a big splash.

fr.name: Gary Burdine
fr.description:
Porte un masque pour effrayer les
autres, mais les fait plutôt rire.

en.name: Gary Burdine
en.description:
Always wears a mask to scare people,
but gets laughed at instead.

fr.name: Chloe Glazier
fr.description:
Elle aime fabriquer des vitraux et en a
installé partout dans sa maison.

en.name: Chloe Glazier
en.description:
She designed all the stunning stained-glass
windows in her house.

fr.name: Reed Harpen
fr.description:
Adore jouer de l'harmonica dans
les parcs publics.

en.name: Reed Harpen
en.description:
He likes honking on his harmonica
and plays regularly at the park.

fr.name: Beat Scatton
fr.description:
Adore le jazz et fréquente bon
nombre de cafés-concerts.

en.name: Beat Scatton
en.description:
A jazz buff who spends a lot of time
looking cool in chic cafés.

fr.name: Al Itchen
fr.description:
Souffre d'une allergie aiguë et
éternue à longueur d'année.

en.name: Al Itchen
en.description:
He suffers from such serious hay fever
that he sneezes all year round.

fr.name: Rock Poulon
fr.description:
Part chaque semaine observer la
faune des fonds marins.

en.name: Rock Poulon
en.description:
He loves studying marine life and
visits the ocean every weekend.

fr.name: Beau Hammock
fr.description:
Grimpe aux arbres du collège et se
fait disputer par les profs.

en.name: Beau Hammock
en.description:
He's an enthusiastic tree-climber who is
always in trouble with his teachers.

fr.name: Clef Bassett
fr.description:
Bassiste dans un groupe de rock.
Surnommé « le bassiste légendaire ».

en.name: Clef Bassett
en.description:
This budding bassist dubs himself
the Four-Stringed Funkateer.

fr.name: Ovie Whisker
fr.description:
Poule, caille ou autre... Adore manger
toutes sortes d'œufs.

en.name: Ovie Whisker
en.description:
Hen's eggs, fish eggs, crocodile eggs...
If you can lay it, he'll eat it.

fr.name: Bill Clanger
fr.description:
Passionné par le métier de pompier.
Vérifie toujours l'état des extincteurs.

en.name: Bill Clanger
en.description:
A fan of traditional fire-fighting,
he always keeps a bucket handy.

fr.name: Mary Cramer
fr.description:
Adore la broderie. A déjà décoré
la banderole des supporters.

en.name: Mary Cramer
en.description:
A raging tapestry fiend who even
embroidered the team's banners.

fr.name: Ralph Vance
fr.description:
Joue les durs et rit tout le temps
pour mieux cacher sa détresse.

en.name: Ralph Vance
en.description:
A tough nut with a hard exterior,
but he's a big softy underneath.

fr.name: Ray Bowing
fr.description:
Ses performances musicales hypnotisantes
fascinent le public.

en.name: Ray Bowing
en.description:
His mesmerizing musical performances
hold his audiences spellbound.

fr.name: Vick Pointer
fr.description:
Un ventriloque prodige qui pratique depuis l'enfance
et ne bouge jamais les lèvres.

en.name: Vick Pointer
en.description:
A ventriloquism prodigy trained since childhood
who never moves his lips.

fr.name: Skip Docker
fr.description:
Maniaque des bateaux qui va au port
chaque jour pour en observer.

en.name: Skip Docker
en.description:
A ship fanatic who watches them go
by every day from the docks.

fr.name: Becky Shuffle
fr.description:
S'entraîne pour devenir championne
de curling.

en.name: Becky Shuffle
en.description:
An avid curling player who hopes to
break on to the international stage.

fr.name: Esther Egerer
fr.description:
Attend le printemps avec impatience
pour décorer les œufs de Pâques.

en.name: Esther Egerer
en.description:
She loves painting eggs and can't
wait for Easter to come round.

fr.name: Mia Pitchford
fr.description:
As de softball. Lance mieux
que tous ceux du club de baseball.

en.name: Mia Pitchford
en.description:
A softball ace. None of the baseball
squad can connect with her fastball.

fr.name: Philippa Konik
fr.description:
Elle comprend les chevaux et excelle
en équitation, même sans cravache.

en.name: Philippa Konik
en.description:
She understands horses so well, she can
make them obey her every command.

fr.name: Amy Stinger
fr.description:
Voudrait devenir
une pro du catch féminin.

en.name: Amy Stinger
en.description:
She's aspiring to become a villain
character in pro female wrestling.

fr.name: Nancy Polearm
fr.description:
Experte en arts martiaux. Ne perd
jamais, même contre les adultes.

en.name: Nancy Polearm
en.description:
This martial artist's moves will put
any wannabe fighter, even adults, to shame.

fr.name: Sally Tare
fr.description:
La reine des jeux de cartes. 
Joue à la vitesse de la lumière.

en.name: Sally Tare
en.description:
A master card player with
lightning-fast reflexes.

fr.name: Anna Bugeisha
fr.description:
Descendante d'une lignée de ninjas,
elle peut disparaître en un clin d'œil.

en.name: Anna Bugeisha
en.description:
She comes from a line of female ninjas
and can disappear in a puff of smoke.

fr.name: Stu Hoofer
fr.description:
Un pro des claquettes qui épate son
monde lorsqu'il danse.

en.name: Stu Hoofer
en.description:
A terrific tap dancer who enthralls
audiences with his performances.

fr.name: Coe Dachy
fr.description:
Admire les samouraïs et porte un
sabre en bois en permanence.

en.name: Coe Dachy
en.description:
Obsessed with samurai, he never goes
anywhere without his wooden sword.

fr.name: Flip Sliden
fr.description:
Adore le snowboard et fréquente
assidûment les pistes l'hiver.

en.name: Flip Sliden
en.description:
Passionate about snowboarding, he
practices all the time in winter.

fr.name: Jesse Spiller
fr.description:
Président du comité de recherche
sur les phénomènes étranges.

en.name: Jesse Spiller
en.description:
He heads a shadowy group researching
the great mysteries of the world.

fr.name: Kate Later
fr.description:
Attire les regards car elle est
toujours en retard d'une mode.

en.name: Kate Later
en.description:
She thought it'd be cool to turn up seven
hours late for a party. No one was there.

fr.name: Clara Tompkins
fr.description:
Elle refuse d'être autre chose que la meilleure
et passe son temps à étudier.

en.name: Clara Tompkins
en.description:
She won't accept second best,
so spends every day studying like mad.

fr.name: Betty Backer
fr.description:
Veut faire carrière à la fois dans le
catch et dans la chanson.

en.name: Betty Backer
en.description:
She aspires to be the half-nelsoning, suplexing,
clothes-lining queen of the ring.

fr.name: Thomas Worth
fr.description:
Sort parfois de sa torpeur pour
prononcer quelques paroles sages.

en.name: Thomas Worth
en.description:
He looks like he's not all there, but he can
surprise everyone with his profound insights.

fr.name: Brenda Brandish
fr.description:
Experte en sabre,
elle découpe tout sur son passage.

en.name: Brenda Brandish
en.description:
A master of the sword,
and the sharpest slicer on the block.

fr.name: Isla Pullens
fr.description:
Les garçons qui lui plaisent tombent
inévitablement dans ses filets.

en.name: Isla Pullens
en.description:
Her gaze is like a tractor beam to any
boy who meets it. Resistance is futile.

fr.name: Bob Jammen
fr.description:
Garçon détendu qui aime par-dessus
tout le reggae.

en.name: Bob Jammen
en.description:
A chilled-out youngster with a love
for reggae music.

fr.name: Hank Cranker
fr.description:
Les diables à ressort qu'il fabrique
effraieraient n'importe qui.

en.name: Hank Cranker
en.description:
He makes everybody jump with his
handmade jack-in-the-boxes.

fr.name: Prunella Keep
fr.description:
A des loisirs passionnants comme
faire sécher des pruneaux.

en.name: Prunella Keep
en.description:
She has perfected the noble art of
pickle-making.

fr.name: Jimmy Brim
fr.description:
S'est servi de sa peluche favorite
pour se fabriquer un chapeau.

en.name: Jimmy Brim
en.description:
He loves his favorite stuffed toy so
much that he turned it into a hat.

fr.name: Verity Soliz
fr.description:
Nul ne peut mentir face à son
regard inquisiteur.

en.name: Verity Soliz
en.description:
It's impossible to lie to her when
caught in her steely gaze.

fr.name: Yve Dunbar
fr.description:
Beaux ou laids, adore les garçons
costauds.

en.name: Yve Dunbar
en.description:
Looks aren't important to her. If a guy
can rip a phone book in half, she's sold.

fr.name: Cat Selima
fr.description:
A l'air effrayante, mais collectionne
les objets liés aux chats.

en.name: Cat Selima
en.description:
She looks terrifying, but she's a sucker for
kittens, hearts and cutesy stuff like that.

fr.name: Aurie Garmer
fr.description:
Elle peut fabriquer un tas de petites
choses simplement avec du papier.

en.name: Aurie Garmer
en.description:
An origami enthusiast who can make
nearly anything out of paper.

fr.name: Lana Service
fr.description:
Chef du club de tennis. Tape mille
balles chaque matin.

en.name: Lana Service
en.description:
Head of the girl's tennis club, she works
on her ground strokes every day.

fr.name: Claire Voyant
fr.description:
Mystérieuse voyante dont les
prédictions sont toujours justes.

en.name: Claire Voyant
en.description:
This mysterious fortune-teller's
predictions never miss the mark.

fr.name: Algy Kelp
fr.description:
N'aime pas les milieux secs et se
réfugie dans les endroits humides.

en.name: Algy Kelp
en.description:
He dislikes dry climates and prefers
to be in humid places.

fr.name: Ann Taisie
fr.description:
Une véritable aristocrate qui
s'intéresse à la vie du peuple.

en.name: Ann Taisie
en.description:
A real-life princess who is fascinated
by how commoners live.

fr.name: Kelly Scrivens
fr.description:
Elle apprend la calligraphie pour
améliorer son écriture.

en.name: Kelly Scrivens
en.description:
She is practising calligraphy and can
do fancy illuminated letters too.

fr.name: Fern Mycota
fr.description:
Fait des recherches sur les
champignons et rêve d'en cultiver.

en.name: Fern Mycota
en.description:
She studies mushrooms and dreams of
mass-producing edible toadstools.

fr.name: Lara Creamer
fr.description:
Aime les vaches. Rêve d'épouser un
agriculteur et d'élever du bétail.

en.name: Lara Creamer
en.description:
Big into all things bovine, she dreams
of rearing her own cows one day.

fr.name: Kim Knotted
fr.description:
Aime les kimonos et aide les gens à
en porter, surtout lors de fêtes.

en.name: Kim Knotted
en.description:
She looks stunning in a kimono and is
always a hit at parties.

fr.name: Nina Trowel
fr.description:
Possède une technique de maquillage
originale venant d'Amérique.

en.name: Nina Trowel
en.description:
A gifted make-up artist who has picked
up tips from around the world.

fr.name: Harriet Reaching
fr.description:
Star du beach-volley qui se
reconvertit dans le foot en hiver.

en.name: Harriet Reaching
en.description:
A beach volleyball star who switches
to footie for the winter season.

fr.name: Sadey Stewer
fr.description:
Chef du club de la voie du thé.
Ses parents enseignent cet art ancien.

en.name: Sadey Stewer
en.description:
Head of the tea ceremony club, she comes
from a long line of tea masters.

fr.name: June Stagner
fr.description:
Jamais bien loin quand un incident
suspect a lieu. Possible espionne.

en.name: June Stagner
en.description:
Odd things occur when she's around.
Word is she's an international spy.

fr.name: Lacey Threader
fr.description:
Habile de ses mains, fabrique divers
accessoires à base de perles.

en.name: Lacey Threader
en.description:
She's adept at making all kinds of
bead jewelry.

fr.name: Marcy Laise
fr.description:
Elle adore la France et s'entraîne
pour devenir chanteuse de variété.

en.name: Marcy Laise
en.description:
Enamored with all things French,
she's learning to sing chansons.

fr.name: Bella Shaded
fr.description:
Porte en permanence des lunettes
de soleil. Sans, elle serait très jolie.

en.name: Bella Shaded
en.description:
She's rumored to be very pretty
underneath those sunglasses.

fr.name: Walter Trope
fr.description:
Cherche des pièces pour assembler
des montres très anciennes.

en.name: Walter Trope
en.description:
He's on a quest for old parts so he can
restore his beloved antique clocks.

fr.name: Flora Summars
fr.description:
Une fille appréciée de tous, gaie
comme un pinson.

en.name: Flora Summars
en.description:
Everybody has a soft spot for this
breezy girl with her summery charm.

fr.name: Lucia Ander
fr.description:
S'entraîne sans relâche pour devenir
danseuse de flamenco.

en.name: Lucia Ander
en.description:
An aspiring flamenco dancer who
never misses her dance classes.

fr.name: Rosy Roker
fr.description:
Chante dans un groupe de musique féminin, 
ce qui lui vaut de nombreuses fans de la gent féminine.

en.name: Rosy Roker
en.description:
Sings lead vocals for an all-girl
band and has many female fans.

fr.name: Pam Vision
fr.description:
Douée pour anticiper, peut prévoir
jusqu'à vingt coups à l'avance.

en.name: Pam Vision
en.description:
Always one step ahead, she's adept
at reading her opponents' moves.

fr.name: Ruth Karnes
fr.description:
Aimerait aller voir des comédies
musicales à Londres ou à New York.

en.name: Ruth Karnes
en.description:
She travels all over the world
to catch the latest musicals.

fr.name: Rose Bedd
fr.description:
Peut faire pousser des roses même
si le climat ne s'y prête pas.

en.name: Rose Bedd
en.description:
She's capable of growing even the most
demanding roses with ease.

fr.name: Bailey Sitter
fr.description:
Grande sœur attentionnée et gentille
malgré son air menaçant.

en.name: Bailey Sitter
en.description:
She looks fierce, but she's kind-hearted
and looks out for her brother.

fr.name: Adel Tactor
fr.description:
Voudrait agir en adulte plus souvent, mais
manque encore trop de maturité.

en.name: Adel Tactor
en.description:
She tries to act like a grown-up, but she's still
really immature.

fr.name: Emma Barres
fr.description:
A du mal à discuter avec des gens qu'elle vient de rencontrer,
surtout si cette personne lui déclare sa flamme.

en.name: Emma Barres
en.description:
She has trouble talking to people she just met.
Runs away if they say they like her.

fr.name: Orpah Talkington
fr.description:
Ne peut s'empêcher de faire du
commérage et le regrette toujours.

en.name: Orpah Talkington
en.description:
She believes everything she hears, which
gets her into all kinds of trouble.

fr.name: Sable Tatter
fr.description:
Douée pour travailler le cuir, elle s'est
fabriqué un cartable et une ceinture.

en.name: Sable Tatter
en.description:
She's great at leatherworking and
makes her own bags and belts.

fr.name: Sym Copate
fr.description:
Batteur dans un groupe. A déjà joué
plus de dix heures d'affilée.

en.name: Sym Copate
en.description:
A drummer in a band. His ten hour drum
solos are quite tiring and quite trying.

fr.name: Jerry Bateman
fr.description:
On aime lui faire des confidences.
Mais il ne se rend pas compte qu'il sait bien écouter.

en.name: Jerry Bateman
en.description:
People confide in him all the time.
He just doesn't know he's that good at listening.

fr.name: Fonda Katz
fr.description:
Se charge chaque jour de nourrir les chats de
gouttière alentour.

en.name: Fonda Katz
en.description:
She feeds the stray cats in the neighborhood
every day.

fr.name: Beck Hand
fr.description:
Spécialiste du frisbee. Ne rate jamais
une réception.

en.name: Beck Hand
en.description:
He's an expert with a frisbee
and never misses a catch.

fr.name: Sandra Mudd
fr.description:
Ses sculptures sur sable sont
appréciées dans le monde entier.

en.name: Sandra Mudd
en.description:
She has received global recognition for
her artworks built from sand.

fr.name: Alexis Watchorn
fr.description:
Elle adore la mer et voudrait devenir
garde-côte.

en.name: Alexis Watchorn
en.description:
She loves the ocean and wants to
work as a lifeguard one day.

fr.name: Pete Manter
fr.description:
Recopie des sutras chaque jour pour
apaiser son esprit.

en.name: Pete Manter
en.description:
He calms his mind and resets his chakras
by chanting mystical sutras every day.

fr.name: Chris Country
fr.description: A déjà remporté un tournoi de ski junior.

en.name: Chris Country
en.description: A skiing ace who won a national junior competition.

fr.name: Paul Steed
fr.description:
Aurait déjà battu un cheval au tir
à la corde.

en.name: Paul Steed
en.description:
Rumor has it that he beat a horse
at tug-of-war.

fr.name: Ben Whistler
fr.description:
Capable de dresser même les chiens
les plus récalcitrants.

en.name: Ben Whistler
en.description:
An expert trainer who teaches even
the wildest dogs to be obedient.

fr.name: Roman Blac
fr.description:
Très fort au bridge, un jeu plutôt
prisé des adultes.

en.name: Roman Blac
en.description:
Bridge isn't just for old ladies—
this kid is a master of the game.

fr.name: Lewis Brownie
fr.description:
Croit aux esprits des fleurs et se
balade dans les parcs.

en.name: Lewis Brownie
en.description:
He believes in flower fairies and goes
searching for them in parks.

fr.name: Connor Seuer
fr.description:
Fin gourmet qui n'a jamais mis les
pieds à la cantine du collège.

en.name: Connor Seuer
en.description:
Born into a family of gourmets, he
turns his nose up at school lunch.

fr.name: Kaya Haskell
fr.description:
Étudie la programmation pour devenir
créatrice de jeux vidéo.

en.name: Kaya Haskell
en.description:
A budding programmer who plans to
become a game designer one day.

fr.name: Minnie Stratio
fr.description:
Douée pour classer les documents.
Aide même les professeurs.

en.name: Minnie Stratio
en.description:
A talented administrator, even
the teachers ask for her help.

fr.name: Elegance Stuckon
fr.description:
Douée en décoration d'ongles, elle
entretient aussi ceux de ses amies.

en.name: Elegance Stuckon
en.description:
She loves nail art and takes care
of all her friends' nails.

fr.name: Odette Musetta
fr.description:
Elle adore le ballet et rêve d'aller en
voir un en Russie.

en.name: Odette Musetta
en.description:
She loves the ballet and dreams of
seeing it in Russia.

fr.name: Gertrude Choker
fr.description:
La reine des judokas du collège.
Rêve de gagner une médaille d'or.

en.name: Gertrude Choker
en.description:
A master judo wrestler who dreams
of earning a gold medal.

fr.name: Polly Targest
fr.description:
Craint les monstres et ne supporte
pas les histoires qui font peur.

en.name: Polly Targest
en.description:
She's terrified of ghosts and runs a mile
at the first hint of a scary story.

fr.name: Odessa Ryder
fr.description:
Adore faire du vélo. Rêve de
grandes plaines à perte de vue.

en.name: Odessa Ryder
en.description:
She loves travelling by bicycle and
dreams of taking a trip up north.

fr.name: Robyn Weaver
fr.description:
Très adroite, elle peut nouer un ruban
de toutes les manières imaginables.

en.name: Robyn Weaver
en.description:
A handy girl who can tie ribbons into
dozens of different knots.

fr.name: Tess Masters
fr.description:
Passe divers tests pour devenir
secrétaire dans une grande société.

en.name: Tess Masters
en.description:
She aspires to be a glamorous high-powered
PA for a big company.

fr.name: Cale Sticklin
fr.description:
Porte un masque pour attirer
l'attention, sans succès.

en.name: Cale Sticklin
en.description:
He started wearing a mask to stand out
from the crowd, but no one noticed.

fr.name: Farris Stickman
fr.description:
Pratique le culturisme, mais maigrit
au lieu de prendre du muscle.

en.name: Farris Stickman
en.description:
He's training hard to develop a muscular
physique, but never loses any weight.

fr.name: Tim Personator
fr.description:
Doit sa coupe et son masque à son
amour des héros de dessins animés.

en.name: Tim Personator
en.description:
He imitates his favorite comic book
heroes by wearing a mask.

fr.name: Sherlock Sagers
fr.description:
Trouve sa coupe très classe, même si
elle lui fait perdre l'équilibre.

en.name: Sherlock Sagers
en.description:
He tries to make his hair look cool,
but it always ends up a bit floppy.

fr.name: Ryan Haywood
fr.description:
Les boutons situés sur son masque lui
permettent de changer d'expression.

en.name: Ryan Haywood
en.description:
His expression changes when he
presses a button on his mask.

fr.name: Osier Twining
fr.description:
Peut fabriquer boîtes et sacs en
utilisant juste herbes et cordages.

en.name: Osier Twining
en.description:
He can weave bags and baskets
from grass and vines.

fr.name: Rock Scowlon
fr.description:
Si inexpressif que son visage
semble être fait en pierre.

en.name: Rock Scowlon
en.description:
Try not to be put off by his stony,
expressionless face.

fr.name: Al Stringer
fr.description:
Veut vivre des aventures grisantes,
mais n'ose pas se lancer.

en.name: Al Stringer
en.description:
He talks about going on exciting adventures,
but he always chickens out.

fr.name: Bill Fierce
fr.description:
Joue les durs, mais est en fait très
peureux.

en.name: Bill Fierce
en.description:
He pretends he's brimming with confidence,
but is really a bag of nerves.

fr.name: Rob Otts
fr.description:
Est persuadé d'être un robot, mais
ne rate aucun repas.

en.name: Rob Otts
en.description:
He's convinced he's a robot, but he still
prefers drinking fizzy pop to engine oil.

fr.name: Chad Jowell
fr.description:
Porte un masque de beauté pour affiner
son visage, sans résultat.

en.name: Chad Jowell
en.description:
He spent a week in a sauna to sweat off
some pounds, but put them straight back on.

fr.name: Egon Omercer
fr.description:
Chez lui, on est si économe qu'on
ne produit aucun déchet.

en.name: Egon Omercer
en.description:
He hates waste, and will make ten cups
of tea with the same tea bag.

fr.name: Luis Springs
fr.description:
S'efforce d'être aussi classe que
son père. Il y a encore du travail.

en.name: Luis Springs
en.description:
He tries to out-cool his dad, but his old
man is way hipper than he'll ever be.

fr.name: Bruce Barkley
fr.description:
Garçon dangereux qui s'énerve pour
un rien.

en.name: Bruce Barkley
en.description:
Some people might hear the call of
the wild. He's got it on speed dial.

fr.name: Chip Spacek
fr.description:
Espion d'origine inconnue. A perdu
la mémoire suite à un choc.

en.name: Chip Spacek
en.description:
A mysterious spy who had their memory
wiped after a blow to the head.

fr.name: Mason Tirell
fr.description:
Des bibelots aux vêtements, peut
tout réaliser à base de caoutchouc.

en.name: Mason Tirell
en.description:
He's an expert at crafting rubber
into anything and everything.

fr.name: Dale Riverhead
fr.description:
Ne cesse de grandir malgré son
faible appétit.

en.name: Dale Riverhead
en.description:
He's packing on the pounds despite
hardly ever eating.

fr.name: Adelpha Lovelace
fr.description:
Les garçons la traitent comme une
sœur, et ne lui font pas la cour.

en.name: Adelpha Lovelace
en.description:
Boys tend to treat her like a pal,
so she rarely gets asked on dates.

fr.name: Egon Timing
fr.description:
Le roi de la cuisson des œufs.
Dur ou mollet, comme il vous plaira !

en.name: Egon Timing
en.description:
Whether you like your boiled eggs
runny or hard, he's your man.

fr.name: Tony Frogge
fr.description:
Son savoir sur les batraciens est
sans limites.

en.name: Tony Frogge
en.description:
An amphibian expert who knows all
there is to know about frogs.

fr.name: Fred Punch
fr.description:
Déteste les fruits locaux et ne
mange que des fruits exotiques.

en.name: Fred Punch
en.description:
A tropical fruit fan who's partial
to papayas and mad about mangoes.

fr.name: Hannibal Whipp
fr.description:
Un pro du dressage qui peut dompter
n'importe quel animal.

en.name: Hannibal Whipp
en.description:
He has a way with animals and can
tame and house train any beast.

fr.name: Luke Severin
fr.description:
Prétend que son nom lui porte
chance.

en.name: Luke Severin
en.description:
A born gambler who's very proud that
his name sounds like "Lucky Seven."

fr.name: Harry Keenan
fr.description:
A l'air toujours très sûr de lui,
mais ce n'est que du bluff.

en.name: Harry Keenan
en.description:
He comes across as very self-assured,
but it's really just a bluff.

fr.name: Nick Uman
fr.description:
Adore la pizza et en mange tous les
jours, même en été.

en.name: Nick Uman
en.description:
This culinary odd-ball serves up piping
hot stews on steamy summer days.

fr.name: Mac Robat
fr.description:
Adore les troupes d'acrobates et
travaille sa souplesse.

en.name: Mac Robat
en.description:
An aspiring acrobat who trains to
make his body more supple.

fr.name: Ace Slider
fr.description:
Patineur de vitesse à l'aise sur
toutes les distances.

en.name: Ace Slider
en.description:
This speed skater is a whizz over
short, medium and long distances.

fr.name: Olivia Twist
fr.description:
Issue d'une famille ancestrale de
tisseurs, ses étoffes sont splendides.

en.name: Olivia Twist
en.description:
She was born into a family of weavers
with a proud tradition of quality.

fr.name: Wiley Blinks
fr.description:
Un as de la grimace si doué qu'il
effraie souvent son interlocuteur.

en.name: Wiley Blinks
en.description:
Don't take him on in a staring contest.
You'll definitely blink first.

fr.name: Shona Shopbell
fr.description:
Elle adore la mode avant-garde et rêve d'ouvrir
sa propre boutique plus tard.

en.name: Shona Shopbell
en.description:
She lives for avant-garde fashion
and dreams of opening her own boutique.

fr.name: Crystal Clears
fr.description:
Sa voix claire et douce attire
l'attention de tous.

en.name: Crystal Clears
en.description:
She has such a beautiful voice, people
all stop and stare when she speaks.

fr.name: Beata Pummel
fr.description:
Championne de karaté du collège qui a déjà mis
K.O. bon nombre d'adversaires.

en.name: Beata Pummel
en.description:
This middle-school karate champ
has knocked out countless opponents.

fr.name: Aya Strand
fr.description:
Apprend à tresser en utilisant des
fils de soie et de coton.

en.name: Aya Strand
en.description:
She's learning to weave cotton and silk
threads into beautiful fabric.

fr.name: Tara Gaudier
fr.description:
Se coiffe d'accessoires voyants.
Rêve de mettre une couronne.

en.name: Tara Gaudier
en.description:
She loves tacky jewelry and dreams
of wearing a gaudy tiara one day.

fr.name: James Hearson
fr.description:
Adore la musique pop et en écoute
même pendant les cours.

en.name: James Hearson
en.description:
He loves cheesy chart hits and secretly
listens to them during class.

fr.name: Anne Somnia
fr.description:
Ne dort pas si elle est stressée.
Passe beaucoup de nuits blanches.

en.name: Anne Somnia
en.description:
If something's on her mind, she won't
sleep a wink all night.

fr.name: Pearl Wann
fr.description:
Douée en tricot, peut même réaliser
un pull-over en une semaine.

en.name: Pearl Wann
en.description:
This nippy knitter can make you a
sweater and a scarf in a flash.

fr.name: Hugh Dunnit
fr.description:
Adore les romans policiers, mais ne
trouve jamais le coupable.

en.name: Hugh Dunnit
en.description:
He loves murder mysteries, but can
never work out who the culprit is.

fr.name: Steve Squander
fr.description:
Panier percé qui dépense son argent
de poche mensuel en une semaine.

en.name: Steve Squander
en.description:
Poor at managing money, he can burn through
a month's pocket money in a morning.

fr.name: Lehman Rind
fr.description:
Aime tout ce qui est acide et croque
les citrons à pleines dents.

en.name: Lehman Rind
en.description:
He loves things that taste sour and is
fond of munching on whole lemons.

fr.name: Ian Fantile
fr.description:
Vouvoie tout le temps ses frères et
sœurs sans raison.

en.name: Ian Fantile
en.description:
He's cheerfully immature in spite
of being the eldest son.

fr.name: Zach Putter
fr.description:
Ne transporte jamais rien avec lui.
Même ses cahiers restent au collège.

en.name: Zach Putter
en.description:
He refuses to carry a school bag and
stashes his books in his locker.

fr.name: Juan Word
fr.description:
Ne répond jamais qu'un seul mot aux
questions posées.

en.name: Juan Word
en.description:
Only ever responds to questions with
one-word answers, even to teachers.

fr.name: Alex Copple
fr.description:
Du genre à foncer sans réfléchir,
il est couvert de bleus en permanence.

en.name: Alex Copple
en.description:
He's forever charging in without thinking
and getting into nasty scrapes.

fr.name: Jan Jared
fr.description:
Elle est toujours à la recherche de
bonnes fraises pour ses confitures.

en.name: Jan Jared
en.description:
She's always searching for juicy
strawberries to make into jam.

fr.name: Bigsby Pigford
fr.description:
Chef du club d'élevage porcin.
Cherche de nouvelles recettes.

en.name: Bigsby Pigford
en.description:
He runs the school farm and has a crew of
snorting, stomping, cud-chewing farmyard pals.

fr.name: Erica Hogland
fr.description:
Sous-cheffe du club d'élevage porcin.
Problème : elle s'attache au bétail.

en.name: Erica Hogland
en.description:
She helps run the school farm and smells
suitably rustic.

fr.name: Ramona Wriston
fr.description:
A les mains si propres qu'elle fait
de la publicité pour du savon.

en.name: Ramona Wriston
en.description:
Her beautiful hands have landed her
a career as a hand model.

fr.name: Mark Izushy
fr.description:
Le roi de la boulette de riz. Peut en
confectionner plus de 100 variétés.

en.name: Mark Izushy
en.description:
This rice ball expert maker can make
over a hundred tasty varieties.

fr.name: Vince Tinct
fr.description:
Ne se rappelle jamais des tactiques
et joue à l'instinct.

en.name: Vince Tinct
en.description:
Unconcerned with strategy and tactics,
he relies purely on natural instinct.

fr.name: Daryl Floor
fr.description:
Elle adore manger aux stands de nourriture
et finit même par trop se gaver.

en.name: Daryl Floor
en.description:
Loves the hustle of food stalls,
but often ends up eating way too much.

fr.name: Becca Pilgreen
fr.description:
Fait de longues balades en montagne
avec un bâton et un chapeau.

en.name: Becca Pilgreen
en.description:
This spiritual lass climbs sacred mountains
with a stick and bamboo hat.

fr.name: Langley Span
fr.description:
Perd ses moyens quand il parle à une
fille et n'arrive pas à la séduire.

en.name: Langley Span
en.description:
He's never had a steady girlfriend as
he tends to lose interest quickly.

fr.name: Swithin Sainte
fr.description:
Élabore des tactiques basées sur le
lien entre météo et forme physique.

en.name: Swithin Sainte
en.description:
He analyses his teammates' conditions and
weather conditions to optimize tactics.

fr.name: Dan Cawarry
fr.description:
Ne pense pas pouvoir gagner s'il ne
mange pas son plat fétiche.

en.name: Dan Cawarry
en.description:
He believes that the key to victory
is a hearty breakfast.

fr.name: Hans Freesing
fr.description:
Artiste spécialiste de la sculpture
sur neige. Très occupé l'hiver.

en.name: Hans Freesing
en.description:
An expert ice sculptor, his work
is put on display at ski resorts.

fr.name: Peter Fakhoury
fr.description:
Roi de la feinte, très doué pour
marquer les joueurs adverses.

en.name: Peter Fakhoury
en.description:
He'll duck, weave, feint, and bob,
and his opponents won't see him for dust.

fr.name: Steve Sancey
fr.description:
Très sensible au toucher, sursaute
même quand on l'effleure.

en.name: Steve Sancey
en.description:
So sensitive, he'll jump out of his skin
if someone so much as brushes past him.

fr.name: Michael Gibe
fr.description:
Se moque de ses interlocuteurs.
Plus personne ne veut lui parler.

en.name: Michael Gibe
en.description:
He has a bad habit of taking the mickey,
so nobody wants to talk to him.

fr.name: Skeet Blaston
fr.description:
Veut devenir homme-canon et voler
dans les airs.

en.name: Skeet Blaston
en.description:
He's training to fulfil his lifelong
ambition and be a human cannonball.

fr.name: Achilles Chinner
fr.description:
Possède un corps robuste dont le
seul point faible est le menton.

en.name: Achilles Chinner
en.description:
He's got a strong physique, but has
a glass jaw.

fr.name: Scott Tickle
fr.description:
Identifie d'un coup d'œil les zones
chatouilleuses des gens.

en.name: Scott Tickle
en.description:
His gift is spotting people's most ticklish
spot. It's not much of a gift.

fr.name: Junior Cage
fr.description:
Pépé éternel redoubleur qui n'a jamais pu
quitter le collège.

en.name: Junior Cage
en.description:
He's never managed to graduate from junior
high and is now a permanent student.

fr.name: Terry Namby
fr.description:
Aime les romans riches en émotions.
Ses yeux sont tout le temps rouges.

en.name: Terry Namby
en.description:
He loves soppy love stories and can't
read them without welling up.

fr.name: Joe Chugger
fr.description:
Doit boire un café chaud avant le
match pour pouvoir se concentrer.

en.name: Joe Chugger
en.description:
He can't focus on the match without a
major dose of hot coffee beforehand.

fr.name: Sonny Cinders
fr.description:
Veut devenir un garçon passionné.
Ses amis le trouvent lourd.

en.name: Sonny Cinders
en.description:
He thinks of himself as fiery and passionate,
but is actually a bit of a disappointment.

fr.name: Cash Winfall
fr.description:
Croit que trouver une pièce datée
de l'année en cours porte chance.

en.name: Cash Winfall
en.description:
He's always rifling through his small change,
looking for freshly-minted coins.

fr.name: Lou Fauntleroy
fr.description:
Imitant les nobles d'Europe, il porte
toujours une perruque bouclée.

en.name: Lou Fauntleroy
en.description:
He wears a curly wig and pretends
he's a European aristocrat.

fr.name: Carol Chanter
fr.description:
Adore le karaoké et peut y chanter
24 heures sans s'arrêter.

en.name: Carol Chanter
en.description:
A raging karaoke fiend who belts
out the classics all day long.

fr.name: Guy Kogan
fr.description:
Aime lire les devises de familles
anciennes et se peindre le visage.

en.name: Guy Kogan
en.description:
He thinks his team's logo is lucky
and even paints his face with it.

fr.name: Max Motto
fr.description:
Grand amateur de héros justiciers,
il s'habille toujours étrangement.

en.name: Max Motto
en.description:
A huge fan of superheroes, he always
runs about in a strange costume.

fr.name: Perry Postiche
fr.description:
Est devenu chauve à force de
tester des coupes extravagantes.

en.name: Perry Postiche
en.description:
Underwent medical trials to give him the
world's coolest hairstyle but went bald.

fr.name: Nelson Levene
fr.description:
Doué pour établir des tactiques
exploitant la psychologie adverse.

en.name: Nelson Levene
en.description:
He psychologically analyses his opponents
in order to get the upper hand.

fr.name: Kurt Sermons
fr.description:
Sa grosse voix lui permet de donner
des directives efficacement.

en.name: Kurt Sermons
en.description:
He's great at projecting his voice.
When he gives orders, people listen.

fr.name: Ed Hartsell
fr.description:
Contrairement aux apparences, il
adore cuisiner pour ses amis.

en.name: Ed Hartsell
en.description:
He loves cooking at home and entertains
his friends regularly.

fr.name: Chester Takes
fr.description:
Cherche à devenir champion de go et aimerait
devenir connu en tant qu'enfant prodige.

en.name: Chester Takes
en.description:
He's great at checkers and chess and hopes
to become known as a child prodigy.

fr.name: Curtis Rebell
fr.description:
Aime les vêtements trop larges et
se heurte souvent aux surveillants.

en.name: Curtis Rebell
en.description:
His unconventional taste in clothing gets
him in trouble regularly with the teachers.

fr.name: Cody Fink
fr.description:
Il réfléchit mieux qu'il n'explique.
Ses idées restent lettre morte.

en.name: Cody Fink
en.description:
A genius whose poor social skills stop
his ideas from getting an audience.

fr.name: Siria Chattsley
fr.description:
Étudie le langage des chiens pour
pouvoir mieux les comprendre.

en.name: Siria Chattsley
en.description:
Researching dog language in order
to find out what they want to say.

fr.name: Darren Catt
fr.description:
Vice-président du comité d'empathie
canine. Les chiens aiment le mordre.

en.name: Darren Catt
en.description:
The vice-chair of the Canine Club,
he's always getting bitten.

fr.name: Garry Planer
fr.description:
Pro de la gravure sur bois. Traîne
dans les boutiques de souvenirs.

en.name: Garry Planer
en.description:
An expert whittler who can carve a block
of wood into anything you like.

fr.name: Glenn Broth
fr.description:
Confectionne son propre miso et en
fait de la soupe chaque matin.

en.name: Glenn Broth
en.description:
He boils stock at home and sups his
own soup all day long.

fr.name: Harry Angue
fr.description:
Parle trop sèchement. Personne ne
l'écoute, même s'il a raison.

en.name: Harry Angue
en.description:
His harsh tone means no one wants to hear
from him, even when he's speaking sense.

fr.name: Benny Terra
fr.description:
Essaye de sauver le monde agricole
avec de nouvelles techniques.

en.name: Benny Terra
en.description:
A committed young farmer who is
outstanding in his own field.

fr.name: Jasmine Veile
fr.description:
Influencée par Les Mille et Une
Nuits, apprend la danse du ventre.

en.name: Jasmine Veile
en.description:
She's learning how to belly dance after
reading 1001 Arabian Nights.

fr.name: Belle Allure
fr.description:
Sa voix est si belle qu'on accède
à chacune de ses requêtes.

en.name: Belle Allure
en.description:
Her voice is so soft and sweet that
people do whatever she asks.

fr.name: Doug Lapp
fr.description:
Préfère les actes aux mots. Écoute
en silence les requêtes des autres.

en.name: Doug Lapp
en.description:
This obliging fellow will do anything
you ask without a word of complaint.

fr.name: Eric Motter
fr.description:
Adore se plaindre
sans jamais essayer d'améliorer sa situation.

en.name: Eric Motter
en.description:
He's always complaining but never does
anything to improve his situation.

fr.name: Gyll Netters
fr.description:
Fils de poissonnier, sait découper
n'importe quel poisson avec un parfait doigté.

en.name: Gyll Netters
en.description:
The son of a fishmonger, he can
fillet any fish in a flash.

fr.name: Farrah Fairway
fr.description:
Veut devenir golfeuse plus tard et
s'entraîne avec son père.

en.name: Farrah Fairway
en.description:
She's trained to be a pro golfer
with her dad since primary school.

fr.name: Jess Winkles
fr.description:
Une écrivaine populaire de romans en ligne,
qui a vu certains de ses récits adaptés en films.

en.name: Jess Winkles
en.description:
A popular online novelist for her age,
with some even having been made into films.

fr.name: Barbara Clector
fr.description:
Passionnée de maisons de poupées,
en a plus de 30 dans sa chambre.

en.name: Barbara Clector
en.description:
A collector of dollhouses, she had thirty
in her room at the last count.

fr.name: Marilyn Henshaw
fr.description:
Insistante, force les autres à
écouter ce qu'elle raconte.

en.name: Marilyn Henshaw
en.description:
Highly-opinionated, she'll give you a piece
of her mind whether you asked for it or not.

fr.name: Nancy Pickney
fr.description:
Déteste ceux qui disent faire tout
leur possible et se moque d'eux.

en.name: Nancy Pickney
en.description:
She hates being told to "Give it 110%"
and sneers at anyone who says it.

fr.name: Clay Turnor
fr.description:
Adore la poterie et réalise de
nouvelles œuvres chaque week-end.

en.name: Clay Turnor
en.description:
An amateur potter who fires new
pieces every weekend.

fr.name: Horace Shlock
fr.description:
Fan de films d'horreur gore. En
possède des centaines en vidéo.

en.name: Horace Shlock
en.description:
A horror movie buff who has
hundreds of videos at home.

fr.name: Sabrina Passman
fr.description:
Cette sprinteuse a déjà battu une rivale de plus d'un tour de piste
lors d'une course scolaire.

en.name: Sabrina Passman
en.description:
This speedy sprinter once lapped a
rival in a school relay race.

fr.name: Harpo Thermier
fr.description:
Né dans le Nord mais déteste le
froid. Voir de la neige le dégoûte.

en.name: Harpo Thermier
en.description:
He was born up north, but hates the cold.
He shudders just looking at snow.

fr.name: August Dyers
fr.description:
Virtuose du ukulélé. L'écouter en
jouer donne la pêche !

en.name: August Dyers
en.description:
An expert ukulele player who can
pluck people's heartstrings.

fr.name: Nev Puffer
fr.description:
Pro de la sarbacane qui met toujours
dans le mille, même à dix mètres.

en.name: Nev Puffer
en.description:
A whiz with a blowpipe, he can hit the
bullseye from ten meters away.

fr.name: Elata Mighty
fr.description:
Donne l'impression de prendre les
gens de haut, bien malgré elle.

en.name: Elata Mighty
en.description:
She tends to speak condescendingly, though
she doesn't mean anything by it.

fr.name: Ben Danna
fr.description:
Collectionne les bandeaux et en
porte un différent chaque jour.

en.name: Ben Danna
en.description:
A headband collector who wears a
different one every day.

fr.name: Elsa Roamer
fr.description:
Fascinée par les nomades,
elle rêve d'adopter un jour leur mode de vie.

en.name: Elsa Roamer
en.description:
She loves the nomadic lifestyle and wouldn't
dream of having a permanent address.

fr.name: Archy Seago
fr.description:
Adore les manchots et aimerait au
moins une fois visiter le pôle Sud.

en.name: Archy Seago
en.description:
He admires penguins and wants to go
on an Antarctic tour some day.

fr.name: Erhardt Knead
fr.description:
Pro de la chiropraxie capable de
requinquer n'importe qui.

en.name: Erhardt Knead
en.description:
An expert masseur. The stiffest
muscles are just putty in his hands.

fr.name: Lynne Mandel
fr.description:
Capable de jouer du taishogoto, 
une sorte de harpe particulière.

en.name: Lynne Mandel
en.description:
This musically-gifted young lady
plays a mean zither.

fr.name: Craig Placid
fr.description:
Sourit en permanence, qu'il soit
heureux ou en colère.

en.name: Craig Placid
en.description:
It's impossible to tell whether this fellow
is happy or angry at any given moment.

fr.name: Leon Morcey
fr.description:
Collectionne les objets antiques en
bronze et écume les brocantes.

en.name: Leon Morcey
en.description:
This bronzeware collector is always
hunting around old tombs.

fr.name: Dom Edarry
fr.description:
Rêve de monter sur un chameau et
voudrait aller au Moyen-Orient.

en.name: Dom Edarry
en.description:
He's obsessed with camels and dreams of
riding around the desert on one.

fr.name: Jay Asher
fr.description:
Il suffit de le regarder pour aller
mieux instantanément.

en.name: Jay Asher
en.description:
So bright and chirpy, people feel
cheered up just by looking at him.

fr.name: Toby Cohill
fr.description:
Porte un masque bizarre et fait des
jeux de mots qui ne font pas rire.

en.name: Toby Cohill
en.description:
He wears a strange mask and tells
jokes, but nobody ever laughs.

fr.name: Nolene Ider
fr.description:
Une jeune fille toujours dans les nuages
qui a tendance à s'assoupir en pleine discussion.

en.name: Nolene Ider
en.description:
She has her head stuck firmly in the clouds
and tends to drift off mid-conversation.

fr.name: Hoots Knightly
fr.description:
Se rend en forêt la nuit pour ses
recherches sur les chouettes.

en.name: Hoots Knightly
en.description:
This owl researcher is often seen
prowling around the woods at night.

fr.name: Bash Beaton
fr.description:
Ses rixes violentes avec son petit
frère inquiètent son entourage.

en.name: Bash Beaton
en.description:
He always ends up in a terrible state
after fighting with his brother.

fr.name: Terry Toolan
fr.description:
Collectionne les essuie-mains et
s'en fait parfois des bandeaux.

en.name: Terry Toolan
en.description:
He has a large collection of hand
towels that double up as headbands.

fr.name: Callum Biddy
fr.description:
Élève un pigeon voyageur, mais n'a
personne à qui envoyer du courrier.

en.name: Callum Biddy
en.description:
He keeps carrier pigeons, but hasn't
managed to send any post yet.

fr.name: Alan Sumner
fr.description:
Un des meilleurs défenseurs du
monde du foot poussin.

en.name: Alan Sumner
en.description:
A world-class defender who's one of
the big four in junior high football.

fr.name: Trixy Wonder
fr.description:
Très forte en tours de magie, elle
adore ébahir ses spectateurs.

en.name: Trixy Wonder
en.description:
She's great at magic tricks and loves
to amaze people with her skills.

fr.name: Colet First
fr.description:
Sa chambre est remplie de premiers
numéros de magazines divers.

en.name: Colet First
en.description:
An avid collector of the first issues
of magazines.

fr.name: Mac Gabbon
fr.description:
Champion mondial junior
au backgammon.

en.name: Mac Gabbon
en.description:
When he's not playing football, he's the
world student backgammon champion.

fr.name: Tip Bolster
fr.description:
Champion des collèges en concours
d'endurance. Point faible : la faim.

en.name: Tip Bolster
en.description:
This stoical soul can endure anything.
...Except an empty stomach.

fr.name: Draco Scallon
fr.description: Prétend être un dragon réincarné.

en.name: Draco Scallon
en.description:
He claims that he is the reincarnation of
a dragon. People nod and smile politely.

fr.name: Sofia Brashier
fr.description:
Femme-sandwich pour un restaurant
chinois aux nems délicieux.

en.name: Sofia Brashier
en.description:
She works front-of-house in a Chinese
restaurant with the best dim sum around.

fr.name: Tam Boyish
fr.description:
Est tellement polie et bien élevée
qu'elle ne donne jamais son avis.

en.name: Tam Boyish
en.description:
This tomboy really lost confidence after
being told to be more ladylike.

fr.name: Mat Halled
fr.description:
Il est toujours sur ses gardes et n'ôte
jamais son bandeau de ninja.

en.name: Mat Halled
en.description:
It's good to be prepared, but that
steel-plated headband is a bit OTT.

fr.name: James Strang
fr.description:
Marche plus de vingt kilomètres par
jour pour garder la forme.

en.name: James Strang
en.description:
He hikes twenty miles a day in order
to keep fit.

fr.name: Ian Watchen
fr.description:
Peut s'orienter en utilisant son esprit
et marcher les yeux fermés.

en.name: Ian Watchen
en.description:
A master of using his mind's eye,
he walks around with his eyes shut.

fr.name: Rose Snelgrove
fr.description:
Traumatisée par une farce étant
petite, elle se méfie des garçons.

en.name: Rose Snelgrove
en.description:
She thinks boys are immature, grubby little
urchins and wants nothing to do with them.

fr.name: Bert Emmerson
fr.description:
Tire des poèmes de ses émotions,
mais a tendance à forcer le trait.

en.name: Bert Emmerson
en.description:
A poet who likes to wax lyrical. He won't
use one word when he can use a hundred.

fr.name: Irving Gusher
fr.description:
Il saigne du nez dès qu'une fille
l'effleure.

en.name: Irving Gusher
en.description:
He gets a nosebleed if a girl so much
as touches him.

fr.name: Lionel Silent
fr.description:
Il adore les vieux films et en regarde
trois par semaine.

en.name: Lionel Silent
en.description:
Loves old films, and watches classics
three times a week.

fr.name: Owen Rage
fr.description:
Est toujours énervé, sans jamais
vraiment savoir pourquoi.

en.name: Owen Rage
en.description:
He is incandescent with rage at all times.
He has absolutely no idea why.

fr.name: Alice Nutty
fr.description:
Est capable de discuter avec les
esprits de la nature.

en.name: Alice Nutty
en.description:
She believes she can talk with fairies,
nymphs and all sorts.

fr.name: Conrad Jacket
fr.description:
Adore le hip-hop et passe son temps
à danser sur ses morceaux favoris.

en.name: Conrad Jacket
en.description:
A big fan of anything with a beat,
he loves to shake his funky stuff.

fr.name: Hilda Bronski
fr.description:
Le pays place de grands espoirs
dans cette skieuse d'Alpin, pour les prochains championnats du monde.

en.name: Hilda Bronski
en.description:
This alpine skier is the nation's big
hope in the next world championship.

fr.name: Clint Peacock
fr.description:
Voudrait se donner un air rebelle,
mais est surtout considéré comme malpoli.

en.name: Clint Peacock
en.description:
He wants to be seen as a rebel,
but just comes across as plain rude.

fr.name: Pace Maker
fr.description:
Administre un forum sur le net qui
reçoit dix mille visites par jour.

en.name: Pace Maker
en.description:
He's the moderator of an internet message
board that gets 10,000 hits a day.

fr.name: Vanity Percy
fr.description:
N'aime pas dépenser son argent et
ne porte que des habits ordinaires.

en.name: Vanity Percy
en.description:
She hates wasting money and her
uniform is from a charity shop.

fr.name: Phil Pagoda
fr.description:
Ému par la peinture traditionnelle
de Chine. Aimerait aller y étudier.

en.name: Phil Pagoda
en.description:
A big fan of Chinese paintings,
he's hoping to study in China.

fr.name: Niki Colbeck
fr.description:
Veut devenir journaliste et publier
un scoop qui fera date.

en.name: Niki Colbeck
en.description:
An aspiring journalist who wants
to cause a stir with a big scoop.

fr.name: Guy Pinnay
fr.description:
Collectionne les posters de stars.
Sa chambre en est recouverte.

en.name: Guy Pinnay
en.description:
His bedroom walls are plastered
with his huge poster collection.

fr.name: Wayne Fluke
fr.description:
Fabrique des porte-bonheur pour
toutes les situations possibles.

en.name: Wayne Fluke
en.description:
Want to be lucky in love? His handmade
talismans are said to work a charm.

fr.name: Red Dayers
fr.description:
Achète de la nourriture pour
animaux et la garde pour lui.

en.name: Red Dayers
en.description:
He ate all the deer feed without sharing
and was cursed to look like this...

fr.name: Shay Diebold
fr.description:
Attire la poisse. Ses amis se font
toujours du souci en sa compagnie.

en.name: Shay Diebold
en.description:
He has a nasty habit of making ominous
statements and making people nervous.

fr.name: Tigh Gerwhite
fr.description:
Fonce à toute allure à la manière
d'un tigre.

en.name: Tigh Gerwhite
en.description:
He charges aggressively like the white
tiger of Chinese mythology.

fr.name: Cerise Crane
fr.description:
Ses déplacements ont la grâce du
phénix.

en.name: Cerise Crane
en.description:
She flies gracefully like the vermilion
phoenix of Chinese mythology.

fr.name: Drack Gorn
fr.description:
Ses sauts évoquent un dragon
filant vers les cieux.

en.name: Drack Gorn
en.description:
He leaps into the air like the azure
dragon of Chinese mythology.

fr.name: Terry Pinn
fr.description:
Sa défense des buts est aussi solide
qu'une carapace de tortue.

en.name: Terry Pinn
en.description:
He is as solid and dependable as the
black tortoise of Chinese mythology.

fr.name: Justin Cush
fr.description:
Doté de solides convictions,
il œuvre pour la justice.

en.name: Justin Cush
en.description:
You can always rely on this fiercely
righteous and honorable fellow.

fr.name: Bert McClure
fr.description:
A l'air songeur en permanence, mais
personne ne sait à quoi il pense.

en.name: Bert McClure
en.description:
A daydreamer who is so distant, you
just can't tell what he's thinking.

fr.name: Richard Trogg
fr.description:
Tire son apparence des histoires
d'ogres qui le fascinent.

en.name: Richard Trogg
en.description:
He's so fascinated by fairytale ogres,
he's actually started to look like one.

fr.name: Shirly Quirk
fr.description:
Aime jouer des tours comme un vrai
petit farfadet.

en.name: Shirly Quirk
en.description:
Her habit of turning up unexpectedly has
led to rumors that she is a ghost.

fr.name: Elias Lens
fr.description:
Élabore une visière spéciale pour
prévoir les déplacements adverses.

en.name: Elias Lens
en.description:
A young inventor developing a device
that predicts people's movements.

fr.name: Terry Dryden
fr.description:
Collectionne les serviettes
inutilisées et les entasse chez lui.

en.name: Terry Dryden
en.description:
His hobby is collecting towels. His
room is full of ones he hasn't used.

fr.name: Ardel Kernel
fr.description:
Type bizarre qui va au cinéma juste
pour manger du pop-corn.

en.name: Ardel Kernel
en.description:
This strange kid likes eating popcorn
more than watching the film.

fr.name: Carl Belcher
fr.description:
Les adultes le reprennent souvent
pour son manque de politesse.

en.name: Carl Belcher
en.description:
This lad is deeply deficient in the decorum
department and gets told off accordingly.

fr.name: Mal Maroon
fr.description:
Adore visiter des îles désertes
pendant les vacances d'été.

en.name: Mal Maroon
en.description:
This anti-social so-and-so spends every
summer on an uninhabited island.

fr.name: Ralph Fary
fr.description:
Garçon mystérieux pouvant mettre fin
à n'importe quelle dispute grâce à son aura étrangement apaisante.

en.name: Ralph Fary
en.description:
This mysterious chap has a curiously calming
influence on those around him.

fr.name: Floyd Spades
fr.description:
Adore jouer aux cartes et les
collectionner.

en.name: Floyd Spades
en.description:
He snaps up exotic sets of playing
cards from all over the world.

fr.name: Remy Diggun
fr.description:
Prodige de l'archéologie. A déjà
exhumé un village ancien.

en.name: Remy Diggun
en.description:
This gifted young archaeologist found traces
of a human settlement in his back garden.

fr.name: Bern Macmahon
fr.description:
Garçon de l'extrême qui aurait un jour
élevé un grizzli.

en.name: Bern Macmahon
en.description:
This rugged fellow has been rumored
to have kept a grizzly as a pet.

fr.name: Wally Cooper
fr.description:
Même les plus forts évitent ce garçon
à la puissance mystérieuse.

en.name: Wally Cooper
en.description:
Even the school bullies steer clear
of him due to his strange power.

fr.name: Griff Hardcasel
fr.description:
Dingue de châteaux. Part en visiter
dès qu'il le peut.

en.name: Griff Hardcasel
en.description:
This history fan has visited
castles all over the country.

fr.name: Pat Lubow
fr.description:
Aime être dépaysé et ne lit que des
romans d'aventures.

en.name: Pat Lubow
en.description:
This adventurous soul can't get enough
of tales of daredevilry and derring-do.

fr.name: Wilma Morgan
fr.description:
Attaquante de choc en volley. Nul
ne peut renvoyer ses smashs.

en.name: Wilma Morgan
en.description:
An ace volleyball player who has
an unbeatable spike.

fr.name: Carys Chaparon
fr.description:
Célèbre pour former des couples,
mais malheureuse en amour.

en.name: Carys Chaparon
en.description:
An expert matchmaker who has trouble
finding Mr. Right herself.

fr.name: Claire Hostess
fr.description:
Grande voyageuse qui
rêve de devenir hôtesse de l'air.

en.name: Claire Hostess
en.description:
An avid traveler who aspires to be
a cabin attendant.

fr.name: Katy Punter
fr.description:
Petite mais très forte en karaté.
Peut casser plusieurs tuiles.

en.name: Katy Punter
en.description:
She may be small, but she's a karate
expert who can chop through wood.

fr.name: Pete Pimento
fr.description:
Adore manger épicé et saupoudre du
piment sur tout et n'importe quoi.

en.name: Pete Pimento
en.description:
He loves spicy food and puts hot chili
sauce on everything.

fr.name: Mary Hugland
fr.description:
Un peu désordonnée, mais très
attentionnée avec ses amis.

en.name: Mary Hugland
en.description:
She might be a bit rough, but she
takes great care of her friends.

fr.name: Lee Screener
fr.description:
Un fou de cinéma qui va voir plus
de cent films par an.

en.name: Lee Screener
en.description:
This film aficionado watches at least
a hundred films a year.

fr.name: Camilla Textor
fr.description:
Fanatique des téléphones, elle répond
aux textos en quelques secondes.

en.name: Camilla Textor
en.description:
A mobile phone whizz, she'll respond
to text messages within seconds.

fr.name: Bish Beaton
fr.description:
Les bagarres entre frères ont
abîmé ses dents.

en.name: Bish Beaton
en.description:
His teeth are a mess after years of
constant scrapping with his brother.

fr.name: Simeon Squareyes
fr.description:
Adore regarder des films en 3D et
porte les lunettes en permanence.

en.name: Simeon Squareyes
en.description:
Loves watching 3D movies and never
takes off his special glasses.

fr.name: Stu Borneman
fr.description:
Tellement borné qu'il refuse
d'admettre qu'il a l'esprit tordu.

en.name: Stu Borneman
en.description:
He makes a point of only doing the exact
opposite of what's expected.

fr.name: Herbie Garnet
fr.description:
Il adore la verdure et a décoré son
pupitre d'une plante en pot.

en.name: Herbie Garnet
en.description:
He loves greenery and even keeps
potted plants on his desk at school.

fr.name: Arvin Inkwell
fr.description:
N'écrit qu'avec des stylos à plume
et en a toujours un sur lui.

en.name: Arvin Inkwell
en.description:
He only writes with his favorite fountain
pen and won't leave home without it.

fr.name: Rayce Sprinton
fr.description:
Coureur de fond qui participe à
plusieurs marathons chaque année.

en.name: Rayce Sprinton
en.description:
This long-distance runner takes part
in marathons on a monthly basis.

fr.name: Dreama Bartle
fr.description:
Semble avoir la tête sur les épaules,
mais s'avère être une vraie cruche.

en.name: Dreama Bartle
en.description:
She looks like she's on the ball,
but she's a bit of a space cadet.

fr.name: Jane Ledbelly
fr.description:
Pratique la natation synchronisée,
mais ne trouve pas de partenaire.

en.name: Jane Ledbelly
en.description:
She seeks a partner as she's struggling to
make it as a solo synchronized swimmer.

fr.name: Dory O'Bonn
fr.description:
Apprend la danse traditionnelle
japonaise et y excelle déjà.

en.name: Dory O'Bonn
en.description:
She's top of the class at her traditional
folk dance workshop.

fr.name: Selma Heaver
fr.description:
Fille guillerette dont le rire franc
met tout le monde de bonne humeur.

en.name: Selma Heaver
en.description:
She has a merry laugh that cheers
and inspires the team.

fr.name: Kath Leaflin
fr.description:
Passe son temps libre dans la forêt
à observer les arbres.

en.name: Kath Leaflin
en.description:
She spends her weekends strolling in
the woods gazing at the trees.

fr.name: Marg Shuttle
fr.description:
Douée en badminton. Regrette le
manque de popularité de ce sport.

en.name: Marg Shuttle
en.description:
This star shuttlecock smacker thinks
badminton beats tennis hands down.

fr.name: Duke Scrubine
fr.description:
Passé maître dans l'art de
nettoyer les toilettes.

en.name: Duke Scrubine
en.description:
This master toilet cleaner can make
even the grottiest U-bends sparkle.

fr.name: Waylon Tripp
fr.description:
Sillonne les mers du monde pour
observer les baleines.

en.name: Waylon Tripp
en.description:
He loves whale-watching and scouts
for spouts all over the world.

fr.name: Jim Bunner
fr.description:
Adore les croissants. Parfois, il ne
mange que ça de la journée.

en.name: Jim Bunner
en.description:
He loves jam buns and eats them three
times a day without fail.

fr.name: Jon Izumo
fr.description:
Adore les déguisements au point de
se peinturlurer le visage.

en.name: Jon Izumo
en.description:
A kabuki aficionado who's never without
his theatrical face paint.

fr.name: Del Brighton
fr.description:
Ravit ses amis en leur envoyant des
cartes postales lorsqu'il voyage.

en.name: Del Brighton
en.description:
He likes sending postcards on his
travels to cheer up his friends.

fr.name: Haden Safe
fr.description:
Son équipe a tendance à se resserrer,
quand il est là.

en.name: Haden Safe
en.description:
For some reason, his team pulls itself
together whenever he's around.

fr.name: Lisle Plotter
fr.description:
Si intelligent que ses tactiques
trop subtiles échouent souvent.

en.name: Lisle Plotter
en.description:
He's a smart cookie, but his strategies
are too elaborate to work on the pitch.

fr.name: Fen Skates
fr.description:
Pratique le patinage artistique
depuis son plus jeune âge.

en.name: Fen Skates
en.description:
She's pursuing her childhood dream to
become a figure skater.

fr.name: Rhoda Dough
fr.description:
Adore préparer des gâteaux si bons
qu'ils ne font pas long feu.

en.name: Rhoda Dough
en.description:
Loves baking cookies! Her cookies
are so good, they're gone in a snap.

fr.name: Neil Seating
fr.description:
Peut s'asseoir en tailleur pendant
des heures sans être courbaturé.

en.name: Neil Seating
en.description:
He loves to sit cross-legged and
not stir an inch for hours.

fr.name: Flo Nighting
fr.description:
Veut devenir infirmière pour pouvoir
aider son prochain et rendre le monde meilleur.

en.name: Flo Nighting
en.description:
An aspiring nurse who wants to help
others and make the world better.

fr.name: Elinor Maven
fr.description:
Jolie fille intelligente et douée pour
le sport. Est devenue solitaire.

en.name: Elinor Maven
en.description:
Smart, athletic and beautiful,
but it's lonely at the top.

fr.name: Kay Gateley
fr.description:
Une parfaite élève qui refuse
que quiconque brise les règles.

en.name: Kay Gateley
en.description:
A school prefect who won't stand
for students bending the rules.

fr.name: Dexter Caise
fr.description:
Collectionne les stylos du monde
entier. Son pupitre en est rempli.

en.name: Dexter Caise
en.description:
His desk is covered in an array of writing
implements from all over the world.

fr.name: Serena Besse
fr.description:
Habile pour amadouer les gens.
Tous les garçons sont fous d'elle.

en.name: Serena Besse
en.description:
She has a gift for flattery and can wrap
any boy around her little finger.

fr.name: Adrian Heartly
fr.description:
S'entend si bien avec les personnes âgées
qu'on le demande à la maison de retraite.

en.name: Adrian Heartly
en.description:
A good listener, she's much in demand
at local old people's homes.

fr.name: Cary Fearless
fr.description:
Se cherche un rival pour donner du
piment à son existence.

en.name: Cary Fearless
en.description:
He's on a quest to find opponents
who can get him really fired up.

fr.name: Wally Waymire
fr.description:
Il étudie la philosophie et emploie des
termes incompréhensibles.

en.name: Wally Waymire
en.description:
He's studying philosophy and uses
lots of really confusing words.

fr.name: Ted Autumn
fr.description:
Ce gardien est un des meilleurs
joueurs poussin de sa génération.

en.name: Ted Autumn
en.description:
This young goalie is considered one
of the big four in junior high footie.

fr.name: Boomer Smolen
fr.description:
Déteste le son de sa voix et
travaille à l'améliorer.

en.name: Boomer Smolen
en.description:
He disliked his own voice, so undertook
speech training to change it.

fr.name: Hank Ershef
fr.description:
Il collectionne les mouchoirs, mais ne
les utilise jamais.

en.name: Hank Ershef
en.description:
He collects handkerchiefs, but would
never use them to blow his nose.

fr.name: Tim Opener
fr.description:
Adore les pêches au sirop et en
mange chaque jour.

en.name: Tim Opener
en.description:
He loves tinned peaches and gets through
a can of them each and every day.

fr.name: Beth Doodle
fr.description:
Douée en caricature, ses dessins
font fureur à la fête du collège.

en.name: Beth Doodle
en.description:
There's always a big queue to get
her to sketch portraits at events.

fr.name: Lamar Bonesteel
fr.description:
Sauve toujours admirablement la
mise en cas de pétrin.

en.name: Lamar Bonesteel
en.description:
No matter what kind of trouble you're in,
he'll be there to lend you his support.

fr.name: Dom Round
fr.description:
Adore ce qui est rond et découpe
jusqu'aux coins de ses cahiers.

en.name: Dom Round
en.description:
He likes circular things so much that
he only writes in round notebooks.

fr.name: Chip Stocks
fr.description:
Toute sa vaisselle est fabriquée en bambou,
y compris ses baguettes et ses assiettes.

en.name: Chip Stocks
en.description:
Everything in his kitchen is bamboo,
from his chopsticks to his plates.

fr.name: Blake Nailor
fr.description:
Aimerait devenir un vieux loup de mer,
mais se trouve trop gentil.

en.name: Blake Nailor
en.description:
Aspires to be a salty old sea dog,
but worries that he's too soft.

fr.name: Dotty Hickman
fr.description:
Ne se remet pas de la disparition du
chat qu'elle a élevé.

en.name: Dotty Hickman
en.description:
She lost her pet cat and is still
pining for her.

fr.name: Wright Tandem
fr.description:
Adore les vieux avions à hélice et
aimerait en restaurer un.

en.name: Wright Tandem
en.description:
A biplane enthusiast who wishes they'd bring
proper propeller-powered planes back.

fr.name: Shaun Bonnie
fr.description:
Cherche dans les livres un moyen
efficace de se perfectionner.

en.name: Shaun Bonnie
en.description:
He reads self-help books as he strives to
be the best Shaun Bonnie he can be.

fr.name: Andrew Hooper
fr.description:
Type étrange qui hurle son nom
lorsqu'il est sur le terrain.

en.name: Andrew Hooper
en.description:
This strange fellow hollers his own
name whenever he's on the pitch.

fr.name: Toya Boyde
fr.description:
Aime les garçons plus jeunes qu'elle
et drague à la moindre occasion.

en.name: Toya Boyde
en.description:
She's looking for a toy boy and isn't
backward about coming forward.

fr.name: Taryn Shyder
fr.description:
Dissimule ses émotions, même face
aux garçons qu'elle aime bien.

en.name: Taryn Shyder
en.description:
She never lets guys know when she's
taken a shine to them.

fr.name: Jasmin Trier
fr.description:
Aimerait devenir geisha et porte
toujours un kimono.

en.name: Jasmin Trier
en.description:
She wants to be a geisha and goes
everywhere in a kimono.

fr.name: Dave Lung
fr.description:
Passe son temps en mer à chercher
les trésors de navires échoués.

en.name: Dave Lung
en.description:
A diving enthusiast who hunts for
treasure in sunken shipwrecks.

fr.name: Teal Redsky
fr.description:
Chef des forces de défense de la ville.
Parle trop.

en.name: Teal Redsky
en.description:
The local squadron leader, he has
a bit of a loud mouth.

fr.name: Truman Verdy
fr.description:
Membre des forces de défense de la ville.
Se cherche une pose.

en.name: Truman Verdy
en.description:
A local squadron member who spends a lot
of time practicing cool poses.

fr.name: Chance Cerulean
fr.description:
Membre des forces de défense de la ville.
Veut se faire remarquer.

en.name: Chance Cerulean
en.description:
A local squadron member who's a terrible
attention seeker.

fr.name: Amy Peach
fr.description:
Seule fille des forces de défense de la ville.
Très peu courtisée.

en.name: Amy Peach
en.description:
The sole girl in the local squadron, she
gets surprisingly little male attention.

fr.name: Virgil Amber
fr.description:
Membre des forces de défense de la ville.
Adore le curry.

en.name: Virgil Amber
en.description:
A local squadron member who can never
get enough curry.

fr.name: Grant Stodgell
fr.description:
Chef des ennemis des forces de défense de la ville.
Actuellement inactif.

en.name: Grant Stodgell
en.description:
The leader of a rival local squadron,
he's far too lazy to do much.

fr.name: Payne Outler
fr.description:
Membre des ennemis des forces de défense de la ville.
Déteste avoir mal.

en.name: Payne Outler
en.description:
A member of a rival local squadron
who is allergic to pain.

fr.name: Malcolm Shirker
fr.description:
Membre des ennemis des forces de défense de la ville.
N'aime pas se bouger.

en.name: Malcolm Shirker
en.description:
A member of a rival local squadron
who opposes work on moral grounds.

fr.name: Hanna Slack
fr.description:
Membre des ennemis des forces de défense de la ville.
Fainéante accomplie.

en.name: Hanna Slack
en.description:
A member of a rival local squadron who
likes to leave things till tomorrow.

fr.name: Dom Poppy
fr.description:
Membre des ennemis des forces de défense de la ville.
Déteste le curry.

en.name: Dom Poppy
en.description:
A member of a rival local squadron
who can't stand spicy food.

fr.name: Portia Maricle
fr.description:
Une artiste née. Incomprise de ses
camarades de classe.

en.name: Portia Maricle
en.description:
An amazing artist, but her peers
just don't understand her.

fr.name: Susan Doiley
fr.description:
Adepte du patchwork qui peut tout
fabriquer, du rideau à la tente.

en.name: Susan Doiley
en.description:
Patchwork is her passion and she makes
it all, from curtains to pillowcases.

fr.name: Hannah Breer
fr.description:
Travaille sa voix pour devenir
doubleuse de dessins animés.

en.name: Hannah Breer
en.description:
She aspires to be a voice actress
and trains non-stop.

fr.name: Phil Seebold
fr.description:
Se soucie trop du regard des
autres.

en.name: Phil Seebold
en.description:
He is far too concerned with how
other people see him.

fr.name: Bobbie Tomey
fr.description:
Ne comprend pas pourquoi les filles
ne parlent que de garçons.

en.name: Bobbie Tomey
en.description:
She gets bored when the other girls
just want to talk about boys.

fr.name: Randolph Lords
fr.description:
Croit être né pour devenir le
maître du monde.

en.name: Randolph Lords
en.description:
He firmly believes that lording it over 
other people is his birthright.

fr.name: Robin Traylor
fr.description:
Adore visiter les usines
désaffectées.

en.name: Robin Traylor
en.description:
His idea of a good time is traipsing
round old, abandoned factories.

fr.name: Fawn Blossom
fr.description:
Veut devenir mannequin, mais trouve
son visage trop enfantin.

en.name: Fawn Blossom
en.description:
She wants to become a fashion model,
but worries her face is too girlish.

fr.name: Isabell Mish
fr.description:
Fille trop sûre d'elle qui ne comprend pas
son manque de succès.

en.name: Isabell Mish
en.description:
She's rather conceited and is blissfully
unaware how off-putting it is for others.

fr.name: Rudy Stemper
fr.description:
Préfère l'action à la réflexion. Sa
rengaine : « Au boulot ! »

en.name: Rudy Stemper
en.description:
He's a doer, not a thinker and is constantly
trying to pep up the team.

fr.name: Betty Evenson
fr.description:
Appréciée de tous pour sa gaieté
et sa franchise.

en.name: Betty Evenson
en.description:
A cheerful, honest girl who is loved
by boys and girls equally.

fr.name: Harpo Kendrick
fr.description:
Il porte un masque à gaz par peur
d'attraper des virus.

en.name: Harpo Kendrick
en.description:
So scared of viruses that he always
wears a military-grade gas mask.

fr.name: Colin Glower
fr.description:
Voit tout en noir et a toujours
l'air renfrogné.

en.name: Colin Glower
en.description:
An inveterate pessimist who always
has a grim look on his face.

fr.name: Tailor Wilden
fr.description:
Traite les renards et les blaireaux
comme des animaux domestiques.

en.name: Tailor Wilden
en.description:
This nature-loving lad raises his own
foxes and badgers as pets.

fr.name: Sim Cebus
fr.description:
Étudie les singes sauvages et se
retire parfois dans la montagne.

en.name: Sim Cebus
en.description:
He hides out on mountains to study
monkeys in the wild.

fr.name: Sam Banks
fr.description:
Son visage gonfle et ses cheveux
se hérissent quand il s'énerve.

en.name: Sam Banks
en.description:
When he gets angry, his face swells
up and his hair stands on end.

fr.name: Frank Homey
fr.description:
Aime la cuisine simple et les
pâtes en particulier.

en.name: Frank Homey
en.description:
He doesn't need haute-cuisine or gourmet
grub. A bag of chips will do him fine.

fr.name: Gregg Deremer
fr.description:
Se dit fiable, mais n'est pas
capable de tenir une promesse.

en.name: Gregg Deremer
en.description:
He thinks he's a laid-back, chilled-out dude.
Everyone else thinks he's a lazy lunk.

fr.name: Verne Spring
fr.description:
Ce génie du foot junior prend
toujours les bonnes décisions.

en.name: Verne Spring
en.description:
This genius tactician is one of the
big four in junior high footie.

fr.name: Bryan Klamm
fr.description:
Essaie de préserver certaines
espèces de poissons de l'extinction.

en.name: Bryan Klamm
en.description:
He's a keen conservationist on a mission
to save all manner of endangered animals.

fr.name: Colt Youngstein
fr.description:
Ne cesse de répéter qu'il est jeune,
contrairement à tous les autres qui sont vieux.

en.name: Colt Youngstein
en.description:
This odd bod boasts about how young he is,
saying everyone else is over the hill.

fr.name: Will Kilmon
fr.description:
Envoie des piques fulgurantes
malgré son visage d'ange.

en.name: Will Kilmon
en.description:
He might look nice, but he's got a
really nasty turn of phrase.

fr.name: Milly Vacey
fr.description:
Adore les hibiscus. Idole du
collège Mary Times.

en.name: Milly Vacey
en.description:
This beach beauty looks very cute
with a hibiscus in her hair.

fr.name: Dany Destiny
fr.description:
Né à Hakata. Ne raterait un festival estival
sous aucun prétexte.

en.name: Dany Destiny
en.description:
Wild horses wouldn't keep this lad from
joining in the town's summer festival.

fr.name: Gary Primo
fr.description:
Chef de la prétendue escouade suprême.
